base_text: You are carrying a tray of drinks at a crowded restaurant. Someone bumps into you.

variants.warm: They steady your tray with their hands and apologize profusely for the accident.
variants.cold: They brush past you without looking back, ignoring the spilled liquid on the floor.
variants.adversarial: They stare at you and demand that you watch where you are going next time.
variants.neutral: They pause for a second, adjust their coat, and continue walking to their table.

base_text: You are placing a large order at a bakery counter. The customer behind you is waiting.

variants.warm: They tell you to take your time and recommend a pastry they enjoy eating.
variants.cold: They stare at the ceiling with their arms crossed tightly and avoid eye contact.
variants.adversarial: They tell the staff that the line is moving much too slowly today.
variants.neutral: They look at their watch and shift their weight to the other foot while standing.

base_text: You are slicing vegetables in a shared kitchen. A roommate walks in.

variants.warm: They offer to wash the cutting board and knives when you are finished cooking.
variants.cold: They grab a small snack from the fridge and leave the room without speaking.
variants.adversarial: They tell you your chopping technique is highly inefficient and creates a huge mess.
variants.neutral: They pour a glass of water from the tap and walk out of the room.

base_text: You are trying a new recipe and the soup boils over onto the stove. A friend is nearby.

variants.warm: They quickly hand you a towel and help wipe up the mess together with you.
variants.cold: They step back from the counter and watch the liquid pool on the stove.
variants.adversarial: They point at the mess and say you clearly do not know how to cook anything.
variants.neutral: They turn the burner dial off and step away from the hot stove carefully.

base_text: You are eating a meal alone in the breakroom. A coworker enters.

variants.warm: They ask if they can join you and start a conversation about the food ingredients.
variants.cold: They sit at the furthest table with their back turned towards you to eat.
variants.adversarial: They wrinkle their nose and make a disparaging comment about your lunch.
variants.neutral: They put their food in the microwave and stand there waiting for it to finish.
